correctness.rationale: Every directed source triangle in regular cyclic tournament R_n occurs in clockwise A,B,C order, forcing all three occupied colors into noninterleaving circular blocks. Unique first occupied anchors have clockwise gaps x,y,z in [1,m] summing 2m+1. Exact additional offsets are m−z,m−x,m−y in disjoint consecutive blocks, totaling m−1; any independent choice respects all cyclic arcs. There are n*C(m+1,2) anchor triangles, each with a Boolean interval on m−1 positions, proving every cell count f_d=n*C(m+1,2)*C(m−1,d), purity, free rotation and chi=0. Reconstructed arc-predicate direct cell sets independently of anchors and checked equality for n=5,7,9,11 with complete vectors (15,15), (42,84,42), (90,270,270,90), (165,660,990,660,165). All-n correctness rests on cyclic-block and extreme-offset inequalities, not finite enumeration.
